ratingRule: Scores are evidence-based judgments. Engineering tests do not establish live operation or competitive leadership. No score is automatically promoted to10.
completionStandard: Complete customer workflow with persisted outcomes and recovery
Current source and provider contracts respected
Independent behavioral and applicable browser/real-database proof
Authorized deployed-build and provider/device evidence where relevant
Competitive comparison based on demonstrated outcomes, not feature labels

features.feature: QR, room links and code entry
features.baselineReason: Low-friction room entry and QR sharing are solid, but established in mixody, Lime DJ and tip.dj.
One account and Pro Mode exist. Current recovery repairs remain unmerged; no-account competitor guest flows set a demanding friction benchmark.
Room setup, owned room selection, restart and closed-state handling exist. A full current live-night journey remains to be demonstrated.
A real usable fallback. Requests and dedications are common competitor baseline features.

features.feature: Curated setlists and request search scope
features.baselineReason: Host can constrain requests to setlist/library/catalog. Useful control, already offered through competitor repertoire workflows.
Autopilot automatically approves eligible moderated requests; it does not automatically mix music or prove playback.

features.feature: Approve, deny, fulfill, hide and remove
features.baselineReason: Good host authority and payment-aware outcomes. Strong fit for performers who cannot guarantee every requested song.
Useful live-set controls; competitor request freezes and caps make this competitive baseline.
Requests, direct tips and boosts have distinct flows. Availability of general live earning is scored separately below.

features.feature: Paid queue ranking and pooled support
features.baselineReason: Approved queues sort by accumulated amount; multiple supporters can back an item. Paid priority already exists in mixody and TouchTunes.
Amount-based ordering exists; no comparable proof of waiting-time fairness, requester interleaving or explicit priority guarantees.

features.feature: Now-playing, queue and request outcome display
features.baselineReason: Room status is useful. Fulfilled/request status is not inherently evidence of the deck playing the same recording.
Title/artist lookup route exists. Less complete than a demonstrated repertoire/lyrics/chords performance workflow.
Durable totals and terminal closeout have recorded evidence; test-volume reporting must remain distinct from payable earnings.
Durable action identity, reconciliation and stale-response defenses are stronger engineering areas; full venue outage endurance remains unmeasured.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineEvidence: Implemented; broader UI in open PR
features.baselineReason: rekordbox XML, Traktor NML, VirtualDJ XML, M3U/CSV and related library paths exist. Importing metadata is distinct from controlling that application.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.feature: Trusted library sync and exact local paths
features.baselineReason: Source keys and the booth bridge preserve trusted paths; browser imports intentionally strip executable paths.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineEvidence: Implemented; fresh hardware run not performed
features.baselineReason: Substantial external-controller path: exact trusted path or search fallback, load/play/pause/stop/cue/next/previous via Network Control.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: Durable command claim/completion and low-rate title/artist/BPM/state feedback; stale state becomes disconnected.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: Generated room-scoped Windows connector reduces setup work; VirtualDJ Pro and its extension still required.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: Advanced Node/repository setup is available, with more friction than a packaged supported desktop connector.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: Can send mapped transport controls. Cannot identify/load the requested track or confirm deck execution.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.feature: Deep Serato, rekordbox, Traktor and djay adapters
features.baselineReason: Exports and generic MIDI provide partial compatibility, not bidirectional native loading/state.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: Opt-in persistent learned controls fit the booth. This improves Sway operation independently of source playback depth.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.feature: Stream Deck and Bitfocus Companion controls
features.baselineReason: Authenticated HTTP presets and bridge endpoints exist; no native self-installing vendor plugin.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: Browser Source URLs, now-playing/up-next/tips/boosts and QR output exist. Competitive baseline; scene automation is absent.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: App-token search uses older size assumptions; incompatible with the newer development-mode contract. Actual live app quota/migration status is unknown.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: App-only import reads the first playlist page using older fields. No pagination or full-playlist completeness check.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: No Spotify user OAuth/Connect control adapter. Official APIs technically support source-owned remote playback.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: No implemented YouTube IFrame controller in the inspected main path; provider-hosted load/play/state APIs are available.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: Catalog marks it not connected; no wired OAuth/playback controller. Official Widget API supports meaningful control.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: No MusicKit adapter found. MusicKit provider playback is technically available, but is not arbitrary-device remote control.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: No direct connector. Catalog/playlist integration and official embeds are separate viable capabilities.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: No partner adapter. Beatsource has migrated into Beatport and should not inflate the source count.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.feature: Per-request source readiness and fallback UX
features.baselineReason: Library matching exists; consistent ready/search-only/unavailable/manual states across providers remain incomplete.

features.area: Sources, playback control and booth integration
features.baselineReason: Windows room launcher exists; no signed installed companion with supported update lifecycle.
PaymentIntent and webhook paths exist; live incoming payments are restricted to exactly one configured performer.
Durable holds and performer-decision capture can make Sway stronger than basic tipping links.

features.baselineEvidence: Implemented; provider outcome not freshly verified
features.baselineReason: Records intended reversals and waits for provider confirmation rather than inventing a successful refund.

features.feature: Customer fee disclosure and net protection
features.baselineReason: Integer-cent pricing and processing recovery exist; conversion impact and actual net economics are unmeasured.
Durable separation of balances and test/live money is useful; no current financial-reporting/accounting-export proof.
Exactly one designated performer, one live withdrawal record and exactly $10 gross. General recurring cash-out is incomplete.
Real destination model and provider path; optional Venmo approval is separated. Receipt by a real recipient was not verified.
No implemented direct bank/debit-card/Cash App withdrawal. Optional expansion, not grounds to erase existing PayPal work.
Masked display, encrypted recipient storage, environment binding and change fencing are sound foundations.
Balance accumulation, minimum and quoted provider fee exist; ordinary repeated live withdrawal remains unavailable.
Durable operations exist. Turning execution off prevents the scheduled payout reconciler from starting after restart.
Audited review records exist; no demonstrated automated identity-provider journey or broad recipient onboarding.
A real public profile displayed identity, photo, biography, music links and socials. Useful beyond an active room.
Performer-type layouts and section arrangement improve utility. Not yet evidence of website-builder-level flexibility.
Working public link presentation; outward links do not confer connected playback or destination analytics.
Five profiles were visible in the inspected directory, including between shows. That observation is not a total-user or market-share count.
Searching Callie returned the matching profile. Broader room/event/release/lyric search exists in code; relevance at scale is unproven.

features.feature: Technical SEO and public share metadata
features.baselineReason: Canonical routes, robots/sitemap and public HTML exist. No Search Console or organic-conversion evidence was available.

features.feature: QR signs, share cards and promotional kit
features.baselineReason: Copy/download/print and public sharing tools are useful. djrequests and Lime DJ already make promotion a core feature.

features.feature: Public visual hierarchy and product wording
features.baselineReason: Readable pages and real imagery; discovery intro overemphasizes rights checks and synthetic-artist policy before the visitor's immediate task.
Observatory and attribution code exist. Instrumentation is not proof of user acquisition or successful experiments.

features.feature: Automatic affiliate enrollment and referral links
features.baselineReason: All-account enrollment, stable links and first valid referral attribution are substantial. No cross-device attribution evidence.
10% standard/20% eligible partner rates apply to captured Sway platform fees, with immutable credit/reversal records.
Service explicitly reports payout not available. Recorded commissions are not a complete affiliate-income product.
Durable projects and permissions provide a useful foundation; BandLab covers a broader creation workflow.
Reservations, ordered parts, idempotent sealing and cleanup exist. Current large-file/mobile-resume behavior was not tested.

features.feature: Immutable masters and exact original downloads
features.baselineReason: Version identity, SHA-256 and exact-byte retrieval after restart have historical evidence.

features.feature: Storage ownership, privacy control and recovery
features.baselineReason: The recorded owning-account/public-access check remains unresolved. This is not evidence that the bucket is publicly exposed.
Pairing alone grants no files; replay protection and deliberate sharing are meaningful strengths.
Granular download/comment/approve grants target an immutable version.
Recipients can receive/review without needing the full performer workspace.

features.feature: Timecoded notes, changes requested and approval
features.baselineReason: Review, approval withdrawal and owner resolution exist. This is review collaboration, not a collaborative DAW.
Revocation and connection cascade remove access; recorded replay denial supports the narrow claim.

features.baselineEvidence: Absent from main sharing path; branch work exists
features.baselineReason: The main sharing service sets canUploadNewVersion=false. Existing owner uploads do not complete collaborator revision return. PR203 remains unmerged.

features.feature: Release metadata, artwork and full credits
features.baselineReason: Editable release/track metadata and optimistic revision protection; downstream delivery remains absent.
Track add/edit/reorder/remove and count validation exist; no store acceptance follows from assembly.
Supplied identifiers are modeled/validated. Operational issuance and migration continuity are not demonstrated.
Immutable declarations and separate reviewer evidence are substantial, with added workflow friction for solo creators.
Writer/lyrics/composition/vocal/production disclosures and consent evidence. Market advantage is unmeasured.

features.feature: Public release pages and profile cards
features.baselineReason: Rights-gated metadata/artwork/credit presentation; not public music listening or proof of store distribution.

features.feature: True pre-save and automatic destination updates
features.baselineReason: Promotional page foundation exists, but not the working pre-save flow DistroKid HyperFollow supplies.
No active real delivery provider. Open sandbox-engine PR142 is unfinished branch work, not delivery to stores.
Modeled states lack real provider execution. Sandbox branch claims additional lifecycle work but remains disabled.
Parity, overlap and approval models do not establish executed store migration or royalty continuity.
No separate operational distribution royalty ledger.
Live-room payments cannot substitute for distribution royalty shares, taxes and payout execution.
Terms/parties/evidence are modeled; complete execution ceremony is not enabled.

features.baselineEvidence: Economic plan; sales runtime not delivered
features.baselineReason: No demonstrated buyer-to-audio-sale fulfillment path. Planned audio fees are separate from streaming economics.
No demonstrated native listening product or current public streaming journey.

features.feature: Sway.DIO funding and artist revenue allocation
features.baselineReason: Subscriptions first, ads/sponsorship later and zero Sway streaming cut are proposed economics, not executed revenue allocation.
Dates/timezone/doors/location/TBA/artwork/visibility and owned-event management exist.

features.feature: Public/unlisted event pages and external ticket links
features.baselineReason: Useful published pages and safe external RSVP/ticket handoff. External provider fulfills the purchase.
Audited cancellation and CTA removal; does not itself refund an externally purchased ticket.
Substantial hosted checkout/order code exists. General production ticket sales remain unverified and gated.
Transactional reservations and backend-confirmed issuance; current production crowd-sale proof absent.
Quantity is hard-coded to one; one issued/pending ticket per verified account per event.

features.feature: Buyer wallet and rotating QR pass
features.baselineReason: Ticket status and short-lived QR/manual codes exist. No Apple Wallet pass integration demonstrated.
Online-only, performer-owner-authorized check-in. Offline staffed-door operation is an important competitor gap.
Seller funds transfer after check-in is distinct from transfer of a ticket to another attendee.
Provider-confirmed full-refund workflow with no-show policy; complete production operation not proved.
Processor events/retries exist; live fee/refund/dispute and post-transfer recovery policy evidence remains missing.
Current v1 excludes it. Seller payout transfers must not be counted as ticket-holder transfers.
Current lane is refund-only; later options remain plans.
10% mandatory service fee with eligible Brand Partner $1 cap. Not universally cheaper after all processing and operational costs.
scrypt, email flows and persisted sessions exist; main lacks today's complete account-recovery repair.

features.feature: Server-owned account, role and room access
features.baselineReason: Ownership, persisted grants, admin/support separation and durable login limiting are real. No fresh penetration test was performed.
Public room projection and receipt-scoped status protect private records; continued regression coverage matters.

features.feature: Moderation, reports and durable active blocks
features.baselineReason: Durable actions and block enforcement exist. Small local English lexicon; no wired AI moderation path established.

features.feature: Installable web app and offline fallback
features.baselineReason: Manifest/service-worker fallback exist. Offline page availability is not offline queue, payment or playback operation.
No current reviewed/signed store release established by the evidence.
Support/legal surfaces and review intake exist; automated verified deletion is not delivered by the intake endpoint.
Readiness/health logic and historical gates exist. Current live marker/API and provider state were not available to this audit.
Repository has behavior, browser, concurrency and contract suites. This assessment did not rerun the full suite.
Large server and performer/audience components still concentrate unrelated responsibilities, increasing regression and integration costs.
